title: Avalon Cybersouth — Type B
property: Avalon, Cybersouth, Dengkil, Selangor — Type B
description: 360° virtual tour of an Avalon Cybersouth Type B double-storey terrace house — car porch and entrance, open living and dining, kitchen and outdoor kitchen, rear and side terraces, a ground-floor bedroom with bathroom, then upstairs the family area, master suite with walk-in closet and en-suite, three more bedrooms, two bathrooms and the balcony.
